name: Cyanova
tagline: The operating system for ink at enterprise scale.
positioning: Cyanova unifies scheduling, consent, and artist utilization across every studio location into one governed booking infrastructure.

hero.h1: Ink operations, orchestrated at the scale of your ambition.
hero.sub: Cyanova turns fragmented studio calendars, paper consent forms, and guest-artist chaos into one governed booking platform — built for multi-location groups that treat tattooing as an enterprise.

features.title: Unified booking fabric
features.description: Route walk-ins, deposits, and multi-session sleeves across every location from a single availability engine that never double-books an artist.

features.title: Consent & compliance vault
features.description: Digitize consent, aftercare, and age verification into an audit-ready record that satisfies legal review in every jurisdiction you operate.

features.title: Artist utilization analytics
features.description: See chair-hours, rebooking rates, and revenue per artist in real time — the metrics your regional managers actually defend budgets with.

features.title: Deposit orchestration
features.description: Automate tiered deposits, no-show recovery, and refunds with policies enforced consistently across hundreds of resident and guest artists.

features.title: Guest-artist provisioning
features.description: Onboard a touring artist to a two-week residency in minutes, with scoped calendar access that expires on schedule.

features.title: Studio-grade integrations
features.description: Sync with your POS, payroll, and identity provider through a documented API that your platform team will respect.

testimonials.quote: We consolidated 14 studios onto Cyanova in a quarter. Double-bookings dropped to zero and our consent audit went from a three-week fire drill to a single export.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The utilization dashboards changed how we plan residencies. We finally staff chairs to demand instead of guessing, and revenue per artist is up 22%.
testimonials.name: Declan Rourke

testimonials.quote: Onboarding guest artists used to mean shared logins and prayer. Cyanova provisions scoped access that expires on its own. Our security team signed off in one meeting.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For single studios formalizing operations on a real platform.
For multi-location groups standardizing across regions.
For national and franchise operators with governance needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Cyanova is the governed booking infrastructure for ink at scale — one platform for scheduling, consent, and utilization across every studio you run.
